claims.text: ``ledger.default_db_path()``, which honours ``DAEDALUS_SPINE_DB``. NOT ``picker.resolve_spine_db_path()``, which ignores that variable (picker.py:438 vs ledger.py:157 -- a live divergence Codex owns; it is not fixed here).

claims.why: The chunk does not contain the implementation of ledger.default_db_path or picker.resolve_spine_db_path, nor the files ledger.py or picker.py.

claims.text: ``sort_keys`` makes two dicts built in different insertion orders produce byte-identical text; ``separators`` strips the whitespace a pretty-printer would vary; ``ensure_ascii`` pins the bytes so a digest does not depend on the reader's encoding.
claims.why: The function call uses sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=True, matching the claim.

claims.text: Mirrors ``memstore._body_sha``'s discipline: one place, one answer to 'what bytes did we hash?'.
claims.why: The chunk does not contain memstore._body_sha; cannot verify the mirror claim.

claims.text: Lives HERE rather than in ledger.py, and ledger.py imports it back, for one structural reason: ledger.py is a CONSUMER of this module (its rows carry a trace and project to statements), so the dependency has to run envelope <- ledger or it is a cycle.
claims.why: The chunk does not include ledger.py; cannot verify the import direction or cycle avoidance.
